sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: By default, Mythical Void stores your creatures, progress, and preferences locally on your device using browser localStorage. If you explicitly enable optional Cloud Save, a versioned copy of your game progress, an anonymous account identifier, and save timestamps are sent to our Supabase database so your progress can be recovered. Cloud Save is disabled by default.

sections.heading: Local Storage
sections.content:
Your primary game save is stored in your browser's localStorage. This means:
• No account or login is required to play
• Clearing browser data can delete local-only saves
• The game remains playable if Cloud Save is unavailable
• Cloud synchronization occurs only after you explicitly enable it

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.content:
Mythical Void uses the following external services:
• Supabase: When Cloud Save is enabled, Supabase provides authentication and database storage for your game progress and maintains security and service logs.
• NASA APIs: We fetch publicly available astronomical images and data. No game profile is sent to NASA.
• Netlify/Vercel: Our game is hosted on static hosting services that maintain standard server access logs such as IP addresses and timestamps.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Mythical Void is designed for players of all ages, including children. No account is required and local play remains available without Cloud Save. Cloud Save is unavailable to profiles that identify as under 13 in this release. We do not intentionally request a child's email address, exact birth date, or physical location for Cloud Save.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content: Local saves remain under your device's control. Optional cloud saves are protected through authenticated access and database policies that restrict each player to their own record. Guardian PIN data and local safety audit history are excluded from cloud uploads. You can disable Cloud Save or delete both its remote save and anonymous cloud identity from the in-game settings.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy as the game develops. Material changes to data collection or Cloud Save will be presented before the affected feature is enabled. The 'Last Updated' date identifies the current version.
